newsitem.title: UK: BFI up nine, South Atlantic more active.
newsitem.headline: BFI up nine, South Atlantic more active.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) was up nine to 1,334 points on Wednesday.

Brokers reported continuing firm conditions for Panamaxes in the Pacific and Continental fixed 54,000 heavy grain NoPac to Japan for mid-July at $13.20 no combo and the BFI route three rose from $12.84 to $13.30 this morning.
But the principle area of fresh chartering activity has been East Coast South America, they said.
Andre fixed Full Spring 69,500 dwt, ballasting from Richards Bay delivery South Brazil mid-July trip Far East at close to $12,700 daily plus $265,000 bonus and were open to repeat the business.
A number of other major grain houses have similar chartering enquiries for July Loading in Argentina and Brazil to the Far East.
Firmer Caper rates were rumoured in iron ore trades such Saldanha Bay to Beilun, reported at $8.25 for August, and also for timecharter requirements delivery Atlantic.
Handy-sizes in the Atlantic remained depressed.
At 1200 GMT BIFFEX was nine to 20 points lower and turnover totalled 75 lots.
